title: A calmer top bar
problem: The top bar had Settings, Invoices and Files buttons that crowded the search and were rarely used.
now: Those three buttons are gone; Store settings stays in the account menu, invoices in Orders, files in Settings › Media.
steps: Look at the top bar: search, Scan, then View store.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
